honesty: Every guide below is written in our own words from the official description plus the sources above. Where PowerPyx says a fact is unconfirmed, we say so too instead of guessing. We played nothing; nothing here is presented as checked in-game unless the source says it was.
list: the official 55 trophies, frozen 2026-11-18 in the bounty kit and re-checked live against Exophase on 2026-11-21

sources.label: Official list — Exophase
sources.what: All 55 names, descriptions and grades; re-checked live, they match the kit's frozen list exactly.

sources.label: PSNProfiles trophy list
sources.what: Grades and PSN progress targets, via the bounty kit's reference; agrees with Exophase on every name, description and grade.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sources.what: Roadmap (difficulty 4/10, ~200 hours, 1 playthrough, 0 online, 0 glitched, 1 possibly missable), save advice, and per-trophy method for all 55 trophies.

trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are yours. There is no extra task, no multiplayer and no DLC requirement.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.note: Difficulty 4/10, about 200 hours, one playthrough, no online trophies. [3]
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies in any order you like.
The platinum unlocks automatically with the last one — most players earn it with Strangers & Freaks or A Long Road.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Play the opening mission Gone Fishing in Chapter 1 and it unlocks when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
steps: Play through the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1.
It cannot be missed — it pops at the end of the mission.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Finish every main mission in Chapter 1; it pops when you complete the first mission of Chapter 2.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
steps: Finish Chapter 1's main missions in order.
The trophy unlocks as Chapter 2 begins.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Finish Chapter 2; it pops when you complete the first mission of Chapter 3.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
steps: Play Chapter 2's main missions through to the end.
The trophy unlocks as Chapter 3 begins.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Finish Chapter 3; it pops after the first two main missions of Chapter 4.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
steps: Play Chapter 3's main missions through to the end.
The trophy unlocks early in Chapter 4.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Finish Chapter 4; it pops when you complete the final main mission of Chapter 4, Starting From Zero.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
steps: Play Chapter 4's main missions through to the end.
The trophy unlocks with the final mission, Starting From Zero.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, and the only gold one tied to the story. Finish the final mission (Chapter 4, Starting From Zero) and it pops with the credits.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
steps: Complete the final mission of the story.
No extra objective — finishing the story is the whole requirement.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run.
trophies.name: Trust
steps: Play the Breakfast Run mission in Chapter 2 to completion.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
steps: Play The Cartel Heist mission in Chapter 3 to completion.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play.
trophies.name: Family Matters
steps: Play the Child's Play mission in Chapter 4 to completion.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
steps: Play the Headliners mission in Chapter 4 to completion.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
steps: Play the VCIA Takedown mission in Chapter 4 to completion.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
steps: Play the Operation Savage Glory mission in Chapter 5 to completion.

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy and the last one most players earn. After the story, the 100% checklist unlocks under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. It is lenient — closer to 60% true completion — and nothing on it is missable: everything can be done in free roam after the story.
trophies.name: A Long Road
steps: Finish the story first; the checklist only becomes viewable afterwards, but progress made during the story already counts.

Work the checklist line by line: any 100 optional missions, 70 of 80 challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 300 stunts, all robberies, all shooting ranges, all drone races and Bret's quests.
Collectibles are only partly required — most types are not needed at all, and the ones that are usually need only 70–80%.

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts. The 100% checklist needs 300, so this pops on the way there. Four kinds count: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridges, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps — mix them however you like.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
steps: Under-the-bridges are the quickest to clear — fly under bridges to tick them off.
Track progress by region under Progress > Activities > Stunts, or on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots.
Performing a stunt once counts as completed; the extra challenges on each map icon are not required.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt.
trophies.name: Master of None
steps: Check Progress > Activities to see which types you have done — scrolling over each shows your count.
Filter the map for Activities (blue dumbbell icon); most types are marked with blue icons once the map is unfogged.
You will do most types naturally while working on other trophies; the checklist's Progress menu tells you what is left.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 shooting range locations. The gold medals are not very difficult, and every range is required for the 100% checklist too.
trophies.name: The Shootist
steps: Visit all 12 shooting range locations and work through their challenges.
Gold each challenge — steady aim beats speed; the medal thresholds are forgiving.
Shooting ranges also raise your Focus level, which helps the Gunslinger trophy.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations (42 drone races in total). Every location is required for the 100% checklist as well.
trophies.name: Top Fun
steps: Find the 14 Top Fun drone race locations around Leonida.
Win at least one race at each location — you do not need to win all 42 races, just one per location.
Drone races also count toward the race-type activity for Master of None.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. There are 40 unique race locations, so you can pick the easiest twenty and ignore the rest.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
steps: Race at 40 unique locations; winning any 20 different ones unlocks the trophy.
Pick short, easy circuits first and save the hard ones — you never need them.
Wins here also count toward the race activity type for Master of None.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 main mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he will text you and mark a fishing location with a purple icon west of Key Lento. Go there and beat him in the fishing challenge.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
steps: Finish the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui (Meet Cal).
Wait for Cal's text, then follow the purple fishing icon west of Key Lento.
Beat Cal in the fishing challenge — it is a short one-off, not a grind.

trophies.guide: Complete any one of the 4 arcade games (called Video Games in-game): Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, or Bang For Your Buck. The first three are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1; the fourth is on arcade machines around the world. You must finish all levels of one game once — beating every challenge is not required.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
steps: Pick any of the 4 video games — the TV at home has the first three from Chapter 1.
Play it through to the end of its levels; challenges inside the game are optional.
It does not matter which game you choose, so take the one you enjoy most.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's optional questline is Lucia-only and gets marked automatically in Chapter 3, when Andy calls and texts her home address in Belville. Complete all 5 of her quests; every one of them is still available after the story.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.note: At risk only because the questline is Lucia-only and starts in Chapter 3 — it is still available after the story. [3]
steps: In Chapter 3, while playing as Lucia, take Andy's call and follow her address in Belville.
Complete her 5 quests: Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, and Puff Puff Pass.
The final quest, Puff Puff Pass, unlocks the trophy.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's questline is marked automatically in Chapter 1, a while after the mission Island Dreams. He calls you, then appears as a green KR icon in Key Lento. He wants you to clear 7 shipwrecks: he marks purple treasure chest icons on the map, you dive, dig the treasure up with the metal detector, and bring it back.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.note: Kenton goes quiet for a stretch of the story and returns in Chapter 2–3 — he is not missable. [3]
steps: After Island Dreams in Chapter 1, take Kenton's call and visit the KR icon in Key Lento.
Dive the shipwrecks he marks, dig up each treasure with the metal detector, and return it to him.
After the first set he calls you back for more — 7 shipwrecks in total. Track it under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Complete his 5 quests; all of them are still available after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
steps: After Coffee Break in Chapter 2, head to the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.
Complete Billy's 5 quests: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler, and Hometown Heroes.
The last quest, Hometown Heroes, unlocks the trophy.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 Strangers & Freaks mission strands. Only certain questlines count — Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count as strangers for this trophy. Confirmed counting strands include Kirk (Skunk Ape), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing) and Pilot Pete (deliveries). Strangers are still there after the story, in free roam.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.note: More counting strangers are still being discovered — the four named here are confirmed. [3]
steps: Do not waste time on questlines that do not count (Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy, Eddie).
Confirmed strands: Kirk's Skunk Ape hunts, Kyle's farm jobs, Yago's races, and Pilot Pete's deliveries.
Check the trophy tracker in the trophy list to see how many strands you have completed.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's Wish List is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 main mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for him and unlock the Key Cloner. He then wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage in west Vice City. It can all be done after the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
steps: Finish Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS in Chapter 3 — the Zorrusso delivery is the first car.
Check Randy's Wish List under Map > Robberies; he marks some cars in fixed locations, and you can steal the rest off the street.
Scan high-end sports cars with the WAiNK app to check if one is on the list, then drive it to his garage in good condition for more money.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's questline is Jason-only and is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 main mission Here, Kitty Kitty. Destroy the Synthetic Labs marked in Vice City, then take his second quest, Spin On This, to shut the labs down. All of it is still available after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
steps: After Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3, follow the purple markers to the Synthetic Labs in Vice City.
Destroy the labs in the quest Take Out Kitty Litter.
Tyrone then gives you Spin On This — shut the labs down to unlock the trophy.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across 10 locations. You can meditate with both Lucia and Jason at each spot, which counts as +2 at the same location. The final spot only becomes possible once both characters can play together, after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.note: THE ONE POSSIBLY MISSABLE TROPHY. The Chapter 1 balcony meditation may be required — it is still unconfirmed whether it counts. Do it in Chapter 1 to be safe. [3]
steps: FIRST — in Chapter 1, the morning after the mission Down to Earth: talk to Lucia in the kitchen at Jason's house, follow her to the balcony, and choose Accept when she offers to meditate. This balcony session adds +1 to your counter but is not marked as a Meditation Spot.
Meditate at all 18 marked spots; doing each with both characters counts +2 per spot.
Track progress under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. For the 100% checklist only 15 of 18 are needed, so a missed balcony session would not block A Long Road.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's questline is Jason-only and starts after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break: while playing as Jason you get a text from Bret marking his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County. He then marks hunting spots on the map; hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him. It is still available after the story.
trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.note: UNCONFIRMED: which animal exactly unlocks this is still being confirmed. [3]
steps: After Coffee Break in Chapter 2, take Bret's text as Jason and meet him in Lummox County for Veteran Hunted.
Bret gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69 — retrieve it from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nation.
Work through his hunting requests; a clean one-shot kill leaves the animal pristine and pays more, but is not required.

trophies.guide: Complete any 3 collectible card sets. There are 18 card set locations across Leonida; collect the cards and finish three full sets.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
steps: Find card locations across Leonida — 18 sets exist in total.
Complete any 3 full sets; you do not need all 18.
Cards are tracked under Progress > Collections, so you can see which sets are closest to done.

trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK locations by holding up and R1 on objects in the environment. There are far more than 100 — landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and tags — so it does not matter which ones you scan.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
steps: Hold up to open the WAiNK app instantly, then look at an object and hold R1 to scan it.
Scan anything: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and more all count.
You will pass 100 naturally while scanning vehicles and exploring; check Progress to see your count.

trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. The 100% checklist needs 70, so this pops on the way. With 10 more challenges than needed, you can skip the hardest ones and pick the easiest fifty.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
steps: View and track challenges under Progress > Challenges.
Many complete naturally while working on other trophies — leave this for near the end, then pick the easiest remaining ones.
You only need 50 of 80, so skip anything that looks slow or hard.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, and escape the heat. The earliest you can do it is after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can free-roam together. Call your partner, cause enough carnage to reach 4 stars, then escape the red heat zone.
trophies.name: Hot Together
steps: After Coffee Break in Chapter 2, call your partner (hold right, press triangle) so you are together.
Reach a 4-star wanted level, then escape in a fast sports motorcycle, cutting through traffic.
The trophy pops after you drive out of the red heat wanted zone — not just the flashing search area. Easiest escape: the train tunnel north of Ambrosia, where the helicopter cannot follow.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, rob 3 shops back-to-back while staying wanted the whole time. Keep the red/blue flashing wanted level — do not lose it between shops and do not let it rise to the red heat level. The unlock is delayed about half a minute after leaving the third shop.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
steps: After Coffee Break in Chapter 2, call your partner and equip an armored vest and sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation.
Rob 3 shops in a row, keeping the flashing wanted level alive between them — loot a couple of items in each store and break the safe in the back room with sticky bombs.
Good spot: the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City, available after Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs. If it does not pop after the third shop, hit a fourth.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Leonida has 557 vehicles at launch; the easiest way is the WAiNK app — stand on a busy road and scan every vehicle that passes. Scanning is enough, you do not need to drive them. The 100% checklist needs 200, so this pops on the way.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
steps: Open the WAiNK app from your phone (hold up for instant use), look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it.
Stand on a busy road and scan everything that passes — new unique vehicles add to your database.
Check totals under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm: time slows and vulnerable spots are highlighted, but it only lasts a few seconds and drains the purple focus bar. Buff your focus first, line up 5 enemies, and do not miss.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.note: Does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians — use gang criminals. [3]
steps: Buff focus before you start: eat, drink, or wash your face / shower at home; consume Adrenaline to extend Combat Focus.
Line up 5 enemies — criminals at gang operations are the reliable target — and wear body armor so you can step out of cover.
Use an assault rifle like the Duke 556: full-auto and more accurate than pistols or SMGs. Focus reaches level 4 naturally as you play, which makes this easier late in the game.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) — the planes on the open airfield do not count. Get inside, go upstairs to the cockpit, drive the plane backwards to the airstrip, take off, and fly at least 1 km away from the airport.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
steps: Drive through a fence around the airfield and head for the plane docked at departure terminals E3/E4 — stairs by the boarding bridge lead straight inside.
Enter the cockpit upstairs, reverse the plane to the airstrip, and take off.
Fly 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport; the unlock is slightly delayed.

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank. Tanks stand in the south of Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. Drive through the gate (or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance), climb in, and shoot enemies until the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
steps: Head to Mile Zero Air Station in the south-west of the map.
Enter the base through the gate or the stunt jump by the south-east entrance.
Climb into a tank in the south of the base and fire at enemies until it unlocks.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish the Chapter 3 main mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — that unlocks the Snap Gun and marks jewelry store robberies on the map. Break in through the back door with the Snap Gun (never kick the door), find the safe code note in the back room, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
steps: Finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 to unlock the Snap Gun.
Enter a jewelry store through the back door using the Snap Gun — kicking the door triggers the alarm.
In the back room, find the safe code, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm. A good spot is Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.

trophies.guide: Rob any 5 bank vaults and escape. Unlock them with the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… — you tail a security van to a bank, a guard carries a briefcase in, and the vault opens. Bring your partner: you cannot carry all the cash yourself. There are 8 large bank jobs in total and the 100% checklist needs all 8, so this pops on the way.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
steps: Finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… to unlock bank vault robberies.
After that, pay Yasmani $10,000 per tip to mark security vans with a purple icon — you must have done his earlier quests first.
Tail a van to its bank, slip in while the vault is open, hand a bag to your partner, and escape on a fast motorcycle. Robbing a vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. It unlocks automatically in the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… — robbing the vault of a large bank counts as robbing an armored truck. Or do it early: block an armored truck driving near a bank in Vice City, plant a sticky bomb on its back door, blow it open, and escape the red heat radius.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
steps: Easiest: play the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… — the first bank vault robbery counts for this trophy.
Early method: find an armored truck near a bank, block its path, stick a bomb on the back door and blow it.
Escape the red heat radius (or use a Pay 'n' Spray) — the trophy only pops once you are clear.

trophies.guide: Fully unfog the whole map of Leonida. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every area that is still black fog until the entire map is visible.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
steps: Get a plane and fly a grid over the map, covering every fogged area.
Watch the map as you fly — fog lifts as you pass over it.
Unfogging the map also reveals activity icons and collectible markers for other trophies.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 illegal gang operations in total and the 100% checklist needs all of them, so this pops on the way. Operations are marked with yellow icons on the map when you go near them.
trophies.name: Pest Control
steps: Look for yellow operation icons on the map as you explore; many are marked automatically from story progress.
Rob one operation for each of the 9 gangs — any one per gang is enough for this trophy.
Track each gang under Progress > Gangs; scrolling over a gang shows how many of its operations you have robbed.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar, buy an Apple Martini, and drink it while standing next to the bar with the Ocean Beach view.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
steps: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach.
Buy an Apple Martini at the bar.
Drink it while standing next to the bar — the trophy pops with the view.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it straight through the showroom window. You can only steal it after obtaining the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 main mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs. It only unlocks from this specific blue Banshee — a nod to the Banshee from GTA III.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
steps: Finish Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs in Chapter 3 to get the Key Cloner.
Go to the showroom in the south of Vice City and hack into the blue Banshee.
Drive forward straight through the window; the trophy pops shortly after, once you are further down the street.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn — one of the gang operations. You go there during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. The valuables are a luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 on a table in the north-east corner, and a safe in the north-east hallway (code 0300, or blow it with sticky bombs). The trophy pops after you escape the police.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.note: Not missable: if you miss a valuable, the robbery icon respawns after a long time and you can grab what is left. [3]
steps: Take the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling to Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn.
Collect the 3 key valuables: the luxury watch (south-east office), the Gutterball shotgun (north-east table), and the safe loot (north-east hallway, code 0300).
Escape the police — the trophy pops after the escape, not when you pick up the third item. Killing enemies is not necessary.

trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Work out together: buy a fitness club membership, always bring your partner along, and while one of you actively works out the other trains automatically — double progress. Check strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength (heart icon).
trophies.name: Personal Best
steps: After the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, you can switch between both characters.
Buy a fitness club membership — filter the map for fitness clubs under Activities.
Always work out together (call your partner along); one character's active workout trains the other automatically. You can also work out at home after the story.

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications first (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On) — a little demon face appears on the right of the screen whenever an action counts. Every robbery and enemy encounter counts, so this happens passively while you work on everything else.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
steps: Turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings > UI > HUD Notifications.
Play normally — robberies, stealthy objectives, clean escapes, and fights all count toward the 500.

Check your count by clicking the trophy in the trophy list. If you are short at the end, farm it by running over civilians and cops with a car — but beware: at Psycho or Irredeemable profile, cops shoot on sight.

trophies.guide: Return to the Payday Loans store Lucia robbed in the Prologue and rob the same store again as Lucia — then escape on foot, not in a vehicle. The earliest you can do it is after the Chapter 3 main mission Credit Check, which unlocks Payday Loans robberies and the Dye Pack Jammer.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
steps: Finish Credit Check in Chapter 3 to unlock Payday Loans robberies.
Go to the Payday Loans in Little Cuba, Vice City, alone as Lucia — without Jason.
Aim at the teller, take out security, break through the door, empty the 3 cash drawers, then run away on foot until you are clear of the police search area. The unlock is delayed — keep running.

trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. At night after 2AM, on the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, you may find a blinking car at the roadside. Follow the path into the woods from it and you will see the UFO. Approach it, talk to the woman it drops, offer to help, and go back to her car at the roadside.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.note: The blinking car spawn is slightly random, not guaranteed — if it is not there, drive away and come back. [3]
steps: Go solo to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2AM.
Look for the blinking car at the roadside; if it is not there, drive away and return.
Follow the path into the woods, approach the UFO, talk to the woman it drops, and walk back to her car.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Ride any bike and kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds. Crowded areas like Vice City or Ocean Beach are the place to do it.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
steps: Get on any bike and ride to a crowded area — Vice City or Ocean Beach.
Kick pedestrians with Square as you ride past them.
You need 10 kicks within 60 seconds, so keep moving and do not stop to fight.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 main mission Credit Check to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer. Then rob banks and Payday Loans, and bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The total counts across all robberies; bank vaults alone can pay up to $205,000 in a few minutes.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
steps: Finish Credit Check in Chapter 3 to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer.
Rob banks and Payday Loans for marked bills.
Deliver the bills to a fence (Yasmani pays best) until the $250,000 total is reached — it accumulates across robberies.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops. The fastest way is the expensive stuff: guns, car mods and tattoos. Any shop type counts and the total accumulates across the whole game.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
steps: Spend across any shops — guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest because they cost the most.
The $100,000 is cumulative, so normal shopping across the story counts too.
If you are short at the end, buy a few expensive weapon mods or a full tattoo set.

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages (4 more are story-related and do not count). They cost $160,000 in total. Garages become available after the Chapter 2 main mission Daily Driver — you get a notification that the Vice City Real Estate app is installed on your phone, and you buy through the app.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
steps: Finish Daily Driver in Chapter 2 to unlock the Vice City Real Estate phone app.
Buy all 8 purchasable garages through the app — $160,000 total.
Robberies are the quickest money, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3–4.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. The app is installed after the Chapter 2 main mission Moses. You need enough garages first — each garage adds parking spots. Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn, click Respray and Register. Initially he only takes vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray.
trophies.name: On the Spot
steps: Finish the Chapter 2 mission Moses to get the Scooter Bros app and unlock Moses.
Buy garages first (see Little Boxes) so you have parking spots to register into.
Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray then Register. Cheap low-end cars and bikes keep the cost down.
